subject: English
question_text: Fill in the blanks with prepositions & articles (a, an, the & zero article). 0.5  10 =
stimulus: Friendship is (a) ⎯⎯ great human virtue. It is (b) ⎯⎯ love and affection between two persons. It binds more than one person (c) ⎯⎯ good relationship and inspires each other to share (d) ⎯⎯ joys and sorrows (e) ⎯⎯ life. Man is (f) ⎯⎯ social being. He cannot live alone. So, he wants (g) ⎯⎯ company. He yearns (h) ⎯⎯ giving and receiving love and affection. Friendship grows between the persons (i) ⎯⎯ similar taste, feelings and thoughts. It grows out of mutual understanding and give and take. It generally grows (j) ⎯⎯ two persons of the same age.
